protocol.role: development mechanism diagnosis using consumed seeds
protocol.source_comparison: 54 original trajectories; native RNG and counters unchanged; on active frames compare opposite selector with cloned pre-call RNG states
protocol.state_roster: all physical action disagreements in every source frame, including drain; same service/duration/sorted class offsets means same action
protocol.intervention: identical prefix, raw-first versus CV-first once, then common frozen v4 K26 on the original arrival tape until all original jobs complete
protocol.sign: all intervention deltas CV-first minus raw-first; fixed sampled margins challenger minus incumbent before orientation
protocol.area_partition: current/future use each action's own frame boundary

repeated_sampling.reuse: one fixed contender-pair estimate per load/queue, shared by occurrences; sample ids crossed across states
repeated_sampling.estimate: raw and corrected fixed-contender means, variances and Monte Carlo standard errors; no selected-minimum margin
repeated_sampling.descriptive_preference: unresolved when absolute mean <= two MC standard errors; no performance gate

protocol.residual_partition: realized minus discovery estimate = fresh proxy mean minus discovery estimate + realized minus fresh proxy mean
protocol.diagnostic_cost: native source work, shadow searches and RNG copies, cached continuation searches, replay frames, and every fresh-sample search/draw reported separately; none added to online K
protocol.stopping_rule: all 54 sources and all disagreements once, then 64 fresh samples for every unique load/queue; no outcome-based filtering, tuning or extra seeds

limitations: Disagreement selection conditions discovery margins. Fresh samples estimate the proxy expectation only on these visited states; 64 samples may leave its sign unresolved.
Realized minus proxy mean mixes arrival-tape noise, horizon cutoff, and two-step/fluid versus v4 continuation. It is not an identified pure model bias.
Sources reuse development tapes and cases have overlapping futures. Counts and means are descriptive, not independent replicates or additive whole-policy gains.
Both raw and corrected estimates have the same fixed-candidate expectation; neither variance reduction nor agreement with continuation is required for execution PASS.
